title: Verity Greeting
blurb: It sounds welcoming. It is not welcoming. That single gap does more work than any jump scare, and it explains why the Verity series took hold the way it did — a cheerful hello in a Minecraft world, delivered by something that has clearly rehearsed being friendly. The clip lands entirely differently once you know where the story goes, which is the mark of good horror writing. Play it when somebody greets you slightly too warmly, or drop it into an edit as the calm before something you have not shown yet.
origin: The introduction greeting from the Verity Minecraft horror series.
